commit_note: 17eeadc only changes the smoke preset's default effort to medium; the archon crate is identical to 1751ed7 (Release 1.2.2).
sandboxes: One fresh $XDG_DATA_HOME/archon-bench/q-<HHMMSS> sandbox per run; every process started with env -i and only HOME, USER, LANG, PATH, TMPDIR and the six private ARCHON_*/AETHER_* variables. Each sandbox aetherd was stopped after its run and no sandbox process remained.
cost_note: Archon trials report cost_gap=interrupted because teardown cancels the orchestrator, so every total is a floor (marked >= in the reports).
path_redaction_note: Operator home paths in the Luna answers and grader output are replaced with $XDG_DATA_HOME; the baseline and calibration evidence contained none.
